profile.what: Mumbai-based drug maker founded in 1977 by the late Gracias Saldanha; run by his son Glenn Saldanha (Chairman and MD). ~US$2bn revenue (FY26 at Rs88.33/$), 80+ countries, ~17,000 staff, 11 manufacturing sites in four countries, three focus therapy areas (respiratory, dermatology, oncology). Owns Ichnos Glenmark Innovation (IGI), a US/Swiss biotech whose trispecific antibody ISB 2001 was licensed to AbbVie in Jul-2025.
